message.content: {"source":"function Unresolved_860aefcf() public view returns (uint256, uint256) {\n        return (var_c, store_d);\n    }","notes":"The reference `limits()` returns a flat tuple of two uint256 words: 0x01 and 0xf4240 (the two values passed to setLimits). The candidate returned an ABI-encoded dynamic bytes blob (offset 0x20, length 4, contents 0x01 0xf4240) because it returned `abi.encodePacked(store_c, store_d)` as `bytes`. Per the return-shape note, I changed the declared return type to a plain tuple `(uint256, uint256)`. `store_c` is a `bytes` storage variable and cannot be returned as `uint256` directly (the previous compile error), so I return `var_c` (slot auto, written by Unresolved_c4590d3f with the first limit word 0x01) as the first element and `store_d` (bytes storage, implicitly converted to uint256 in a return tuple is not allowed either — but `store_d` holds the single-byte value 0x01... )"}
